Description
The artwork of Pop Artist Burton Morris takes center stage on the Burton Morris American Icons – Pop! 1 oz Silver Coin. Renowned for his bold, comic-style depictions of everyday objects, Morris, often compared to a modern-day Andy Warhol, uses his art to comment on American popular culture. The 999.9 silver coin, shaped and colorized, features a bucket of popcorn from Morris’s 2012 piece
Pop!
, rendered in his signature vibrant colors and dark outlines. Silver accents provide striking contrast against the vivid hues, enhancing the overall design.
This 99.99% fine silver 1 oz collectible, minted by PAMP, has a limited edition of just 2,500 coins worldwide. It is presented in specially designed packaging with a large window for display. This collectible is a must-have for fans of Burton Morris and pop art alike.
